body:
﻿Reproduced on integration head b7a8c9ddac in src/ui/room-template-world-bridge.ts.

Press/release to place a room plan, hold the placement-port confirmation pending, move the cursor to a different tile, then accept the placement. The room is accepted but the tool remains armed because the hover query increments the same request revision used to filter the committed placement response. This can invite unintended repeated placement.

A focused production-path regression fails: expected tool.isArmed() false, received true. Expected: the accepted command disarms its original tool even if the preview moved. A newly armed/selected tool must still be protected from an older confirmation, and a stale refusal must not repaint a newer preview. Fix in progress, no save or player-copy change.
title: Room plans remain armed when cursor movement supersedes placement confirmation
